note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate castes are all described, the nymph is not. The hind wing length is not recorded because the figures are incomplete owing to OCR damage. Synonymy citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: head capsule brownish yellow; antennae, labrum and pronotum yellow; mandibles brownish black; body pale yellow. Head sparsely pilose, body more densely so. Total body length 4.3–5.2 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, length to base of mandibles 1.40–1.67 mm, maximum width 0.90–1.00 mm; width more than half the length and slightly less than two thirds, width/length ratio 0.56–0.64. Fontanelle minute, situated at about the anterior third of the head. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Labrum with anterior margin obtusely rounded, sides parallel, length 0.20–0.25 mm, width 0.25–0.27 mm. Mandibles shorter than two thirds of the head length, 0.86–0.97 mm long, left mandible length/head length ratio 0.59–0.63; anterior half distinctly incurved; coarsely serrate, with a larger tooth-like process behind the middle. Postmentum clavate, length 0.85–1.02 mm, maximum width 0.29–0.35 mm, waist width 0.19–0.22 mm; waist situated posteriorly. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.27–0.35 mm, width 0.53–0.66 mm; anterior margin distinctly emarginate, posterior margin weakly concave or nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head capsule brownish yellow, body pale yellow. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Total body length 3.6–4.8 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, length to base of mandibles 0.8–0.87 mm, maximum width 0.87 mm; sides nearly parallel. Fontanelle not visible. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus convex, pilose, length about half its width or slightly more than half. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.17–0.25 mm, width 0.45–0.57 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Alate: head capsule, pronotum and abdominal tergites chestnut brown; antennae, labrum and abdominal sternites brown; wings pale smoky brown. Head and body densely pilose. Body length with wings 8.5–9.2 mm, without wings 4.7–5.7 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, length to base of mandibles 0.83–0.90 mm, width including compound eyes 0.83–0.90 mm; sides nearly parallel; Y-shaped suture distinct. Frontal plate small, indistinct. Compound eye broadly oval, maximum diameter 0.20–0.25 mm, minimum diameter 0.20 mm; its distance to the lower margin of the head one third of its diameter. Ocellus oval, major axis 0.07–0.10 mm; distance to the compound eye about half its major axis, i.e. 0.04–0.07 mm. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus weakly convex, pilose; length equal to or slightly more than half its width. Pronotum trapezoidal, length 0.40–0.51 mm, width 0.65–0.72 mm; anterior margin nearly straight with a weak median emargination; posterior margin shallowly concave. Wing surface microsculpture consisting of 1–2 rows of acute spine-like papillae on the anterior and posterior margins, and of non-stellate (4–6-armed) and stellate (5–6-armed) microtrichia on the membrane. Fore wing 7.45–8.0 mm long.
